items.title: NATIVE: a LOANED resource PARAMETER walked by `for` still emits the move form (`let mut iterator = param;`) - F153's borrow covers `let` bindings and by-value parameters, not a `&mut` parameter
items.kind: native backend defect (cargo refuses; F153 residue)
items.discussion: lane native-56 (Order 56): not exercised by the F153 fixtures; probably the same E0382/E0308 family
items.body: Extend `for_each_resource_subjects` to a loaned parameter (the iterator is the parameter itself, reborrowed: `let iterator = &mut *param;`); pin with a function taking `keys: &mut Keys` that walks it and the caller using it after. Sizing XS-S.
